task_name: RTE 25% EWS/DG Free-Seat Admission in a Private Unaided School
citizen_input: Parent's online application for an EWS/DG free seat (child's birth proof, income/caste certificate, residence proof, distance declaration)
outcome: Child admitted free of cost to a private unaided school against a reserved 25% seat, reimbursed by the state
source: RTE Act 2009 s.12(1)(c) and s.12(2); Uttarakhand RTE online admission portal (registration, BEO verification, lottery, allotment)

task_name: MGNREGA Job Card Issue and Guaranteed Work Demand
citizen_input: Household application for a job card at the Gram Panchayat, then a dated written application demanding work
outcome: Job card issued and wage employment provided within 15 days (else unemployment allowance), with wages paid within 15 days of work
total_days: ~30 days job-card issue to first wage payment (15 to allot work + 15 to pay wages)
source: MGNREGA 2005 s.3 (15-day work guarantee), s.3(1) unemployment allowance, s.3(3) delayed-wage compensation 0.05%/day; MGNREGA Operational Guidelines 2013 (muster roll, measurement book, GRS/JE roles, wage FTO, social audit)

task_name: Land Mutation (Dakhil Kharij / Namantaran) — recording change of ownership in the land record
citizen_input: Application to record a transfer (sale/gift/inheritance) with registered sale-deed / succession documents, filed at the Tehsil
outcome: Khatauni (record of rights) amended to reflect the new owner; certified copy of updated khatauni issued
legal_basis: UP Revenue Code 2006 (ss. 33, 34, 35) / UP Land Records Manual
total_days: ~35-45 days (45-day disposal deadline enforced by state directive; longer if contested)
source: UP Revenue Code 2006, s.35 (mutation; proclamation; uncontested/contested; appeal to SDO within 30 days); UP Revenue Code 2006 ss.33-35 bare act; 45-day dakhil kharij disposal deadline (state directive)

task_name: Building Plan / Housing Construction Permit (Naksha Sanction) in a Nagar Nigam
citizen_input: Building plan drawings (CAD/AutoDCR), site/ownership documents, application fee via the OBPAS single-window portal
outcome: Sanctioned building plan + permit/sanction letter authorizing construction
legal_basis: UP Building Construction & Development Bye-Laws 2008; UP Urban Planning & Development Act 1973; Janhit Guarantee Adhiniyam 2011; OBPAS/AutoDCR
total_days: 15-30 days statutory (15 via OBPAS auto-scrutiny; 30 under Building Bye-Laws)
source: UP Building Construction & Development Bye-Laws 2008 (amended 2016); UP OBPAS/AutoDCR single-window portal; Janhit Guarantee Adhiniyam 2011 (Right to Public Services)

citizen_input: Online application via e-District/CSC (or at Tehsil) with self-declaration, ID, address and supporting proofs
outcome: Digitally-signed caste / income / domicile certificate delivered to the applicant
legal_basis: UP Janhit Guarantee Adhiniyam 2011 (Right to Public Services) / e-District UP
total_days: ~7-15 working days (statutory limit under the Janhit Guarantee Adhiniyam schedule)
source: UP Janhit Guarantee Adhiniyam 2011 (Right to Public Services; first appeal 30 days, second appeal 60 days); e-District UP income/caste/domicile process & Lekhpal verification timelines

task_name: Ration Card (New / Member Addition) under NFSA
citizen_input: Application form + Aadhaar, residence/income proof, family details via e-district/CSC/Supply Office
outcome: Ration card issued (priority/AAY category) with a Fair Price Shop assigned
legal_basis: National Food Security Act 2013 (ss. 10, 12, 14, 16); state TPDS Control Order; e-district
total_days: 30 days statutory (NFSA inspection/verification norm); card collectable up to ~45 days in practice
source: National Food Security Act 2013 (ss.10,12,14,16); Uttarakhand FCS Dept URCMS / e-PDS ration-card process; NFSA 30-day inspection/verification norm; DGRO -> State Food Commission appeal
